;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Papua conflict]]
**A priest is shot dead, allegedly by [[Indonesian National Armed Forces|Indonesian army]] in [[Intan Jaya Regency]], [[Papua (province)|Papua]]. The military denies the allegations and blames the [[Free Papua Movement]] for the shooting. [https://www.mbs.news/en/2020/09/a-priest-was-shot-dead-by-kkb-in-intan-jaya-papua-page-all.html (MBS)]

;Arts and culture
*A 1634 edition of ''[[The Two Noble Kinsmen]]'', the last [[Shakespeare's plays|play]] written by English playwright [[William Shakespeare]], is discovered at the [[Royal Scots College]]'s library in [[Salamanca]], [[Spain]]. It is believed to be the oldest copy of any of his works in the country. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-54209767?intlink_from_url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world&link_location=live-reporting-story (BBC News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Internet censorship in the United States]], [[China–United States trade war]]
**Chinese [[technology company]] [[ByteDance]] announces a proposed joint deal with American corporations [[Oracle Corporation|Oracle]] and [[Walmart]] to continue the operation of its [[Online video platform|video-sharing]] [[social networking service]] [[TikTok]] in the United States under the name Tiktok Global. [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] recognizes the proposal, having threatened to ban the service in suspicion of [[Chinese espionage in the United States|Chinese espionage]] should ByteDance have failed to reach a deal with an American firm. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/tiktok-confirms-proposed-deal-with-oracle-walmart-for-us-business/article32651986.ece#:~:text=Popular%20video%20app%20TikTok%20announced,against%20the%20Chinese%2Downed%20platform. (AFP via ''The Hindu'')] [https://www.npr.org/2020/09/20/914032065/tiktok-ban-averted-trump-gives-oracle-walmart-deal-his-blessing (NPR)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Cyclone Ianos]]
**A rare [[Mediterranean tropical-like cyclone]] (medicane), with winds up to 120 km/h (75 mph), kills three people as it passes over [[Greece]] heading toward the island of [[Crete]].  About 5,000 homes in [[Karditsa]], Greece, were affected by flooding and heavy winds. One person is still reported missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54219180 (BBC)] [https://greekcitytimes.com/2020/09/21/cyclone-ianos-leaves-3-dead-causes-extensive-damage/ (''Greek City Times'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Robert Koch Institute]] reports 2,297 new cases in [[Germany]] in the last 24 hours, the highest single daily increase since April, taking the nationwide total to more than 270,000. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/germany-records-highest-single-day-rise-in-covid-19-cases-since-april/amp (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reports a record daily jump of 1,002 new cases, according to the [[Ministry of Health (Poland)|Health Ministry]]'s [[Twitter]] account, the highest daily increase since the [[pandemic]] began. The new record comes days after the authorities tightened conditions under which doctors are obliged to send patients for testing. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/poland-reports-record-daily-coronavirus-cases (Reuters via ''National Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports 847 new daily cases, bringing the cumulative totals to 68,025 confirmed cases and 1,899 deaths. Ever since the end of national [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] in May, this has been the fifth time that the country has registered some record increases in new cases, with all five records occurring during an 11-day window. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/201_DGS_boletim_20200919.pdf (DGS)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
***[[Indonesia]] reports a daily jump of 4,168 new cases, bringing the country's total cases to 240,687. This sets a new record high for the country since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5179812/pecah-rekor-tambah-4168-kasus-corona-di-ri-19-september-jadi-240687 (detikNews)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uganda]]
***[[Uganda]] reports 423 new cases, its highest daily increase, thus bringing the country's total cases to 6,017. [https://xinhuanet.com/english/2020-09/19/c_139381821.htm (Xinhua)]

;International relations
*[[United States sanctions against Iran]]
**The [[United States Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] declares the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|2015 nuclear accord]] with [[Iran]] as no longer in force. He also warns that the [[United States]] "is prepared to use our domestic authorities to impose consequences" for other countries that do not enforce the sanctions. [[United Kingdom|Britain]], [[France]], [[Germany]], [[China]], and [[Russia]] oppose the snapback sanctions. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/09/19/us/politics/us-iran-un-sanctions.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/09/claims-sanctions-iran-reinstated-world-disagrees-200920053722999.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Canada–China relations]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Canada)|Canadian Foreign Minister]] [[François-Philippe Champagne]] announces that [[Canada]] has ceased discussing any [[free trade]] agreements with China. Canada has walked away from free-trade talks with [[China]] amid soured relations over arrest of [[Huawei]] CFO [[Meng Wanzhou]] and the detention of [[Michael Kovrig]] and [[Michael Spavor]]. He states that "the China of 2020 is not the China of 2016". [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3102178/canada-has-abandoned-free-trade-talks-china-says?utm_term=Autofeed&utm_medium=Social&utm_content=article&utm_source=Twitter#Echobox=1600454665 (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[Bangladesh–India relations]], [[Deaths along the Bangladesh–India border]]
**The border guards of [[Border Guards Bangladesh|Bangladesh]] and [[Border Security Force|India]] agree to launch joint patrols along [[Bangladesh–India border|the two countries' border]] following a spate of deaths linked to [[Illegal entry|illegal entries]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/bangladesh-india-agree-to-curb-border-killings-/1978850 (Anadolu)]

;Law and crime
*[[Immigration detention in the United States]]
**Police arrest 86 people at a protest against the [[Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] in [[Times Square]]. The rally called for the abolition of ICE in the wake of allegations of a [[Compulsory_sterilization#United States|high rate of hysterectomies]] and alleged medical neglect. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/09/20/us/times-square-nyc-ice-protest/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] (FBI) releases a statement that a screening facility for [[White House]] mail intercepted a package containing [[ricin]] poison that was addressed to [[Donald Trump]] earlier this week. The FBI and the [[United States Secret Service|Secret Service]] are investigating where the package came from and whether others have been sent through the [[United States Postal Service|postal service]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54221893 (BBC News)]
*[[Central African Republic Civil War (2012–present)|Central African Republic Civil War]]
**A [[Paris]] [[Judiciary of France|court]] indicts Eric Bagale, a former presidential guard of former [[Central African Republic]] [[Heads of state of the Central African Republic (and Central African Empire)|President]] [[François Bozizé]] and head of an [[anti-balaka]] [[militia]], for "[[complicity]] in [[crimes against humanity]]" and "criminal association for the preparation of a [[war crime]]" on acts his militia committed between 2007 and 2014. [https://guardian.ng/news/france-indicts-central-africa-war-crimes-suspect/ (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
*Aftermath of the [[Hachalu Hundessa riots]]
**The [[attorney general]] of [[Ethiopia]] files [[terrorism]] charges against opposition activist [[Jawar Mohammed]] for the unrest that erupted following the [[assassination]] of musician [[Hachalu Hundessa]] last June. Jawar is due to appear in court on Monday to respond to the charges. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-politics/ethiopia-files-terrorism-charges-against-leading-opposition-activist-idUSKCN26A0LW (Reuters)]
*[[Rochester shooting]]
**Two people are killed and 14 others injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a home in [[Rochester, New York]]. It is the largest mass shooting in the city's history. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/09/19/rochester-new-york-shooting-house-party/5837515002/ (''USA Today'')] [https://www.democratandchronicle.com/story/news/2020/09/19/rochester-mass-shooting-near-public-market/5836840002/ (''The Rochester Democrat and Chronicle'')]
*Former [[United Kingdom|UK]] spy Fraser Cameron is reportedly placed under investigation by [[government of Belgium|Belgian]] authorities for allegedly selling sensitive information to [[government of China|Chinese]] spies posing as journalists. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-54213041 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Protests over responses to the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]]
**Hundreds of [[Romanians|Romanian]] families protest at the [[University Square, Bucharest|University Square]] in [[Bucharest]] against the [[Government of Romania|government]]'s new mandate on [[Social distancing measures related to the COVID-19 pandemic|social distancing]] and the wearing of [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|face masks]] in schools. Many compare the measures to the [[Socialist Republic of Romania|country's communist regime]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/romanian-families-protest-mandatory-masks-school-73117820 (AP via ABC News)]
*[[2020 Thai protests]]
**More than 15,000 pro-democracy protesters led by students of the [[Thammasat University]] gather near the [[Grand Palace]] in [[Bangkok]], calling for the resignation of [[Prime Minister of Thailand|Prime Minister]] [[Prayut Chan-o-cha]] and his government as well as a reform of the [[Monarchy of Thailand|Thai monarchy]]. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/09/19/20/tens-of-thousands-of-protesters-join-thailand-pro-democracy-rally (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
